OpenCode Digital Pet

A Digimon companion that evolves as you use OpenCode.

Your partner grows with your OpenCode sessions. Hatch an egg, discover branching evolutions, collect Digimon in the Dex, and revisit past companions in History. Progress is shared across your sessions and with Cursor Digital Pet on the same computer. ![Illustrative OpenCode partner, Dex and history views](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jcendal/digital-pet/main/assets/screenshots/digital-pet-overview.png) ## Quick start You need **OpenCode 1.18.10 or newer** and **Node.js 24.11.0 or newer** for the installer. 1. Install the plugin: ```sh npx @jcendal/opencode-digital-pet init ``` 2. Restart OpenCode. 3. Run `/digital-pet-spawn` to hatch your first partner. ## Evolution Completed assistant messages give your partner experience. Work in concurrent sessions contributes to the same companion. When its gauge fills, it evolves along one of its available branches and begins progressing toward the next stage. Use `/digital-pet-freeze` to pause growth and `/digital-pet-unfreeze` to resume. Usage while frozen does not count toward evolution. There are **650 Digimon** to discover, with evolution lines from the original V-Pets. ## Commands | Command | What it does | | --- | --- | | `/digital-pet-spawn` | Starts a new egg. | | `/digital-pet-freeze` | Pauses progression. | | `/digital-pet-unfreeze` | Resumes progression. | | `/digital-pet-set ` | Selects a Digimon by catalog ID. | | `/digital-pet-dex` | Opens your Dex. | | `/digital-pet-history` | Opens current and past generations. | Selecting a Digimon with `/digital-pet-set` does not count toward Dex completion. The [partner catalog](https://github.com/jcendal/digital-pet/blob/main/packages/opencode-digital-pet/docs/partners.md) lists the available IDs. ## Update ```sh npx @jcendal/opencode-digital-pet update ``` Restart OpenCode afterward. If you used the older `opencode-vpet` plugin, remove its registration from your OpenCode configuration to avoid loading both. ## Settings Edit `opencode-digital-pet.json` to configure notifications, Digimon names, and evolution speed. | Platform | Settings file | | --- | --- | | macOS / Linux / WSL | `~/.config/opencode-digital-pet.json` | | Windows | `%APPDATA%\opencode-digital-pet.json` | | Setting | Purpose | | --- | --- | | `notifications` | Turn notifications on or off. | | `language` | Use Japanese (`jp`) or English (`en`) Digimon and stage names. | | `stageThresholds` | Set the experience required for each evolution stage. | Default configuration: ```json { "notifications": true, "language": "jp", "stageThresholds": { "egg": 5000000, "babyI": 10000000, "babyII": 20000000, "child": 40000000, "adult": 75000000, "perfect": 125000000, "ultimate": 200000000, "superUltimate": 300000000 } } ``` The interface supports English, Korean, Spanish, and Galician and follows your system language. Set `DIGITAL_PET_LANGUAGE` to `en`, `ko`, `es`, or `gl` to choose one explicitly. This is separate from the Digimon naming setting. An existing `opencode-vpet.json` remains in use until you create the new settings file. ## Storage Your companion, Dex, and History are saved locally in `pet.db`. Back up this file to keep a copy of your progress. | Platform | Save file | | --- | --- | | macOS | `~/Library/Application Support/opencode-digital-pet/pet.db` | | Linux / WSL | `~/.local/share/opencode-digital-pet/pet.db` | | Windows | `%APPDATA%\opencode-digital-pet\pet.db` | An existing `opencode-vpet/pet.db` continues to be used if the new save does not exist. ## Help and contributions Report issues or suggest features in the [repository](https://github.com/jcendal/digital-pet/issues). Development guidance is in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/jcendal/digital-pet/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Credits and license Maintained by [Jorge Cendal](https://github.com/jcendal), with [Sergio Bugallo](https://github.com/sbugallo) as original author and contributor. Licensed under [Apache 2.0](LICENSE). Sprites were derived from [sundeth/omnipet](https://github.com/sundeth/omnipet/tree/main) and [Tortoiseshel's Full Color Digimon Dot Sprites post](https://withthewill.net/threads/full-color-digimon-dot-sprites.25843/), then edited for this project.

# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

The format is based on [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.1.0/),
and this project adheres to [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/spec/v2.0.0.html).

## [0.16.0] - 2026-10-21

- Repair DoneDevimon's identity, missing LoaderLeomon/Crowmon branches and eight pair-only routes without adding species or changing saved IDs.
- Count duplicate DORUguremon IDs once in automatic evolution selection, preserve legacy pending duels, and let final forms keep earning EXP and fighting threshold duels.

### Changed

- Adapt device evolution victory minimums to game pacing (12→3, 24→5, 50→7, 200→10) in shared rules and the Dex, preserving care alternatives and existing counters.
- Use locally bundled, species-specific projectiles in shared battles: all 109 PENOG sprites and reviewed assignments for 526 catalog entries; retain the existing fallback where source data is missing.

## [0.15.1] - 2026-10-15

### Changed

- Restore Lopmon and other omitted evolution branches from reviewed device detail cards, keep fusion/special routes out of ordinary EXP selection and preserve withdrawn targets for pending saves.
- Give each companion its own adventure cooldown, preserve the principal's legacy timer and keep adventure waits advancing in reserve while apple and care timers pause.

## [0.15.0] - 2026-10-14

### Changed

- Start the evolution duel at 100% even without an eligible route. Count a win before choosing the target; without a result, retain the companion and victory, show the notice and reset EXP.
- Persist adventure and evolution-duel victories per form, prevent replayed rewards and show numeric Dex requirements only on applicable routes.
- Prepare shared SQLite team persistence for two owned companions, preserving the existing active pet during migration and keeping token receipts on the principal. Team controls are not exposed yet.
- Choose experience evolutions from referenced normal routes according to the current 0–3 unclean piles. Exclude Jogress and unverified routes from automatic evolution.

## [0.2.0] - 2026-10-06

### Changed

- Renamed the product and packages to Digital Pet under the `jcendal` namespace.
- Kept existing `opencode-vpet` settings and database paths readable so current partners remain available.
- Updated release metadata for the `jcendal/digital-pet` repository and credited Sergio Bugallo as the original author.

## [0.1.1] - 2026-08-30

### Fixed

- Exported the OpenCode server plugin entrypoint so VPet commands and the sidebar load correctly.
- Updated `init` and `update` to delegate to OpenCode's native global plugin installer with the
  installed exact package version, avoiding stale bare or `@latest` cache reuse.

## [0.1.0] - 2026-08-30

### Added

- Server and TUI plugins that add a Digimon virtual pet to the OpenCode sidebar.
- Progression from completed assistant-message token usage, including reconciliation of completed 
  usage from concurrent sessions.
- Toast notifications for spawning, progression controls, and Digimon evolutions.
- A 650-Digimon catalog spanning eight evolution stages, with evolution paths and Japanese and 
  English names.
- Partner generations that can be spawned, evolved, frozen, unfrozen, or set to a catalog ID.
- Sidebar progress and status display, including frozen and manually set partner states, with 
  animated walking, action, and sleep behavior.
- Dex and History dialogs for browsing discovered Digimon and current or retired partner 
  generations, with links to external encyclopedia entries.
- `/vpet-spawn`, `/vpet-freeze`, `/vpet-unfreeze`, `/vpet-set <id>`, `/vpet-dex`, and 
  `/vpet-history` commands.
- SQLite persistence for partners, progression events, usage receipts, trainer totals, and control 
  state.
- Global settings for language, evolution thresholds, and notifications.
- `npx @sbugallo/opencode-vpet init` and `npx @sbugallo/opencode-vpet update` commands that register 
  server and TUI plugins while preserving unrelated JSON and JSONC configuration.
